Priya: Heads up — Sasha Li submitted a resignation this morning. Last day 2026-05-26. Need to coordinate asset return, access removal, and COBRA notice window.
Marcel: Thanks. I'll take lead on knowledge transfer. Can we lock down last-week calendar for handoffs? @Sasha please add docs to the /team/runbooks repo.
Sasha Li: Yep will do. I'll share a 1-pager with key flows by EOD.
Jules (IT): For access: plan to suspend SSO and AWS console access on final day at 18:00 PT, disable GitHub org membership, and revoke personal API keys. Anything else?
Marcel: Also rotate service account creds for infra pipelines Sasha touched: infra-deploy and realtime-batcher.
Jules (IT): Noted. I'll run a staged deprovision script and post logs. Tentative commands:
```
# suspend SSO
redwood-iam suspend-user --email sasha@redwood.ai --effective 2026-05-26T18:00:00-07:00
# remove GitHub org membership
gh api -X DELETE /orgs/redwood/memberships/sasha
# rotate infra service tokens
infractl creds rotate --selector owner:sasha
```
Jules (IT): I'll tag @marcel and @priya in the runbook for manual approvals if anything human-required pops up.
Aisha (Benefits): COBRA timing: active benefits run through 2026-05-31 (end of month). COBRA election notice will be generated and emailed within 48 hours of termination. Coverage retro to 2026-06-01 if elected. Enrollment link: https://benefits.redwood.ai/cobra
Priya: Great — can you confirm whether COBRA notice goes to personal email on file? We need to ensure SSA/alternate contact if not.
Aisha (Benefits): It goes to personal email on file by default. If Sasha prefers postal, we can send a mailed packet — takes ~5 business days.
Marcel: Sasha, please confirm best email and whether you want a mailed packet.
Sasha Li: Personal email is sasha.personal@gmail.com, no mail needed.
Jules (IT): Running deprovision dry-run tomorrow 2026-05-20 09:00 PT, final run on 2026-05-26 18:05 PT. I'll post the dry-run log here.
saas-deploy-bot: deprovision-dryrun completed for sasha@redwood.ai — no blocked steps (job id dj-4521)
Jules (IT): Dry-run output: removed GitHub org membership test, flagged 3 infra tokens for rotation, SSO suspension simulated. No surprises.
Marcel: Thanks. I'll schedule a 30-min knowledge transfer with Eng tomorrow. Calendar invite sent.
Priya: I'll prepare the exit interview link and make sure payroll has final paycheck + accruals calculation.
Sasha Li: Appreciate everyone's help. Leaving notes in /team/runbooks/sasha-oncall.md
Priya: Closing loop — action items:
• Jules: run final deprovision on last day
• Aisha: send COBRA email within 48h
• Marcel: host KT and confirm service account rot
• Sasha: drop final docs and laptop return slot
Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
